verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents securing an API with OAuth 2.0 using scopes and granular permissions, including machine-to-machine flows (auth0-docs-2, auth0-docs-81, auth0-docs-54). Its AI marketing says agents can get identities and connect to MCP servers more securely (auth0-docs-20, auth0-docs-68), but nothing shows a documented recipe for putting an authorization flow in front of your own MCP server that complies with the MCP spec. Its Auth0 MCP Server only manages your Auth0 tenant and does not cover this story. Missing for 10: MCP-authorization-spec compliance (e.g. dynamic client registration, protected resource metadata), a first-party guide for securing a customer MCP server, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
